title: Dynamic Routing Chains
summary: This module provides various chain implementations for dynamically routing user inputs or queries to different sub-chains or prompts. It supports routing based on embedding similarity or decisions made by a Language Model.

nodes.label: Route via Embeddings
nodes.title: EmbeddingRouterChain
nodes.description: Routes incoming queries to a destination chain by finding the most similar embedding in a vector store, useful for semantic routing.

nodes.label: Route via LLM Decision
nodes.title: LLMRouterChain
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to decide which destination chain or prompt to route the input to, based on the LLM's understanding of the query. This class is deprecated in favor of more flexible Runnable implementations.

nodes.label: Route to Multiple Prompts
nodes.title: MultiPromptChain
nodes.description: Routes an input to one of several predefined prompts, each associated with a specific sub-chain, using an LLM router to make the selection. This class is deprecated.

nodes.label: Route to Multiple Retrieval QA Chains
nodes.title: MultiRetrievalQAChain
nodes.description: Routes an input query to one of multiple retrieval-augmented question answering (QA) chains, each potentially using a different retriever or prompt, based on an LLM router's decision.

nodes.label: Define Routing Chain Interface
nodes.title: RouterChain
nodes.description: Abstract base class for chains that perform routing logic, directing inputs to different downstream components.

nodes.label: Define Multi-Route Chain Interface
nodes.title: MultiRouteChain
nodes.description: Abstract base class for chains that manage routing between multiple distinct sub-chains or destinations.

nodes.label: Store & Search Embeddings
nodes.title: VectorStore
nodes.description: A database optimized for storing and querying high-dimensional vector embeddings, enabling similarity searches.

nodes.label: Generate Text Embeddings
nodes.title: Embeddings
nodes.description: A component responsible for converting text into numerical vector representations (embeddings) for semantic analysis.

nodes.label: Execute LLM with Prompt
nodes.title: LLMChain
nodes.description: A chain that takes a prompt template, formats it with input variables, and passes the result to a language model.

nodes.label: Interact with Language Models
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: An abstract interface for interacting with various language models, providing a consistent API for different LLM providers.

nodes.label: Define Prompt Structure
nodes.title: BasePromptTemplate
nodes.description: An abstract base class for prompt templates, defining the structure and variables for generating prompts.

nodes.label: Format Prompts
nodes.title: PromptTemplate
nodes.description: A concrete implementation of a prompt template that formats a string with input variables.

nodes.label: Parse Router Output
nodes.title: RouterOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses the output from a language model to extract routing decisions, typically identifying a destination and relevant inputs.

nodes.label: Define Chain Interface
nodes.title: Chain
nodes.description: The fundamental abstract base class for all chains, defining the basic interface for processing inputs and producing outputs.

nodes.label: Define Retrieval QA Interface
nodes.title: BaseRetrievalQA
nodes.description: An abstract base class for retrieval-augmented question answering chains, combining retrieval with LLM generation.

nodes.label: Retrieve Documents
nodes.title: BaseRetriever
nodes.description: An abstract interface for retrieving relevant documents or information based on a query.

nodes.label: Perform Retrieval-Augmented QA
nodes.title: RetrievalQA
nodes.description: A chain that performs question answering by first retrieving relevant documents and then using an LLM to generate an answer based on those documents.

nodes.label: Manage Conversational Flow
nodes.title: ConversationChain
nodes.description: A chain designed to manage and maintain conversational context and flow, often used for chatbots.

groups.label: Routing Logic
groups.title: Core Routing Mechanisms
groups.description: Components responsible for the fundamental decision-making process of routing inputs.

groups.label: Multi-Chain Orchestration
groups.title: Orchestrating Multiple Chains
groups.description: Components that manage and route inputs across various specialized sub-chains or prompts.

groups.label: LLM & Prompting Foundations
groups.title: Language Model and Prompting Tools
groups.description: Essential components for interacting with Language Models and structuring prompts for effective communication.

groups.label: Data & Retrieval Foundations
groups.title: Data Storage and Retrieval Components
groups.description: Components for managing data, generating embeddings, and retrieving relevant information for processing.

groups.label: Base Chain Abstractions
groups.title: Fundamental Chain Building Blocks
groups.description: Abstract and concrete base classes that define the core structure and behavior of various types of chains.
